description: This file implements the software side of IRQ handling for a Zephyr-based POSIX simulation environment, including interrupt vector management, IRQ handling, priority setting, and IRQ offloading.

methods.name: vector_to_irq
methods.description: Handles dispatching of IRQs based on vector table, manages direct and normal IRQs, and performs tracing.

methods.name: posix_irq_handler
methods.description: Main IRQ handler that processes pending IRQs, manages nested IRQs, and performs thread switching if needed.

methods.name: nsif_cpu0_irq_raised_from_sw
methods.description: Handles software-initiated IRQs, invoking the main IRQ handler if higher priority IRQs are pending.

methods.name: posix_irq_lock
methods.description: Disables all interrupts and returns a lock key.

methods.name: posix_irq_unlock
methods.description: Re-enables interrupts using the provided lock key.

methods.name: posix_irq_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ is enabled.

methods.name: posix_get_current_irq
methods.description: Returns the currently running IRQ number.

methods.name: posix_isr_declare
methods.description: Configures a static interrupt with its handler, parameter, and flags.

methods.name: posix_irq_priority_set
methods.description: Sets the priority of a specific IRQ.

methods.name: posix_irq_offload
methods.description: Runs a function in interrupt context by offloading via a software IRQ.
